pages.title: Harp Seal
pages.text: The harp seal ($(o)Pagophilus groenlandicus$()) is a seal of the North Atlantic and Arctic, named for the dark harp-shaped band across the back of adults.$(br2)Pups are born on the pack ice in a fluffy white coat, which they shed after a few weeks.$(br2)Harp seals gather in enormous breeding colonies on the ice each spring.
